name: EduCloud course host
author: EduCloud
description: One private AWS host for Waypoint JupyterHub with separately owned course storage.

parameters.name: course
parameters.description: Waypoint course instance name and EduCloudCourse tag on the retained volume.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region containing the course resources.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Reviewed Waypoint host AMI with course services disabled until storage and identity are verified.

parameters.name: flavor
parameters.description: Operator-selected CPU instance size for the active group.

parameters.name: subnet_id
parameters.description: Existing subnet with a private route from the course edge.

parameters.name: home_volume_id
parameters.description: Existing encrypted course home volume in the same availability zone.
